 This is a paid press release. Contact the press release distributor directly with any inquiries. Singapore's FriedRice to Hire 30 Locally as It Accelerates Expansion Across Asia-Pacific
 PR Newswire Tue, November 17, 2026 at 1:00 AM EST 8 min read Live entertainment and immersive exhibitions group strengthens Singapore as its regional creative and operational hub, with plans for new offices in Guangzhou, Shanghai and Hong Kong, and expanded operations in Southeast Asia 
 SINGAPORE, Nov. 17, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Singapore-headquartered entertainment group FriedRice is embarking on its next phase of regional expansion, with plans to establish offices in Guangzhou, Shanghai and Hong Kong, strengthen its existing operations in Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok, and recruit 30 additional professionals in Singapore by mid-2027. The group is made up of concert promoter FriedRice Entertainment and immersive experiential entertainment arm FriedRice Experience. 
 The expansion marks a significant step in FriedRice's transformation from a live entertainment business into a broader regional entertainment and creative production group, with growing interests in concerts and international touring, immersive entertainment, theatrical productions and intellectual property development. 
 At the heart of this growth is Singapore, which FriedRice intends to strengthen as the centre of its regional creative, production and international operations. The company's investment in local talent and capabilities will support its expansion into new markets while creating opportunities for Singapore-based professionals to participate in increasingly ambitious international productions. 
 "Singapore is more than just the location of our headquarters. It is where we want to build the people, expertise and creative capabilities that will drive our growth across Asia-Pacific," said Mr James Zou, Chief Executive Officer of FriedRice. 
 "Asia-Pacific is not one market, and you can't run it from one city. As we expand into more markets, our ambition is to develop a Singapore-based entertainment group with the capabilities, relationships and regional reach to compete and collaborate internationally. We want to build a business that brings the world's best entertainment to Asia, while also creating opportunities for talent and ideas from Singapore and Southeast Asia to reach audiences beyond our shores." 
 From Singapore to the Global Stage: Strengthening Its Greater China Presence 
 FriedRice Entertainment has steadily established its presence across Asia-Pacific through a growing portfolio of concerts, international tours and large-scale live productions. In 2026, the company is presenting a total of 40 shows across nine cities, up from 36 shows across six cities in 2025. The growth in its live entertainment portfolio reflects its expanding regional reach and growing relationships with international artistes, producers and entertainment partners. 
 Story Continues Its 2026 programme included Mark Tuan's two-night fan-con at Bangkok's 12,000-seat IMPACT Arena, Korean band JANNABI's first Asia tour, which ran from June to August 2026 across four cities, and Japanese star Ryosuke Yamada's first overseas solo concert at Seoul's Jangchung Arena. Its programming spans J-pop, K-pop, Mandopop, family entertainment and orchestral productions, and other artistes it has worked with include Eric Chou, CNBLUE, WOODZ and IRENE. These productions have strengthened FriedRice's experience in managing large-scale concerts, coordinating international tours and navigating the different commercial, creative and operational requirements of markets across Asia-Pacific. 
 Building on this track record, FriedRice is moving towards a more closely connected regional operating model. The group plans to establish offices in Guangzhou, Shanghai and Hong Kong, strengthening its access to Greater China's entertainment industry, bringing FriedRice closer to artistes, intellectual property owners and venues in Greater China, and supporting cross-border touring and co-productions. FriedRice has already staged shows in Guangzhou and Macau this year. 
 At the same time, FriedRice is expanding its existing operations in Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok, with additional local recruitment and enhanced operational responsibilities. The regional offices will support local market development, identify new entertainment and production opportunities, and facilitate cross-border collaborations and international touring. They will also support the expansion of FriedRice's immersive entertainment business. 
 "Asia-Pacific is an exciting but highly diverse entertainment market. Each city has its own audiences, venues, partners and commercial dynamics," said Mr Zou. "Having a stronger presence in these markets allows us to understand local audiences better, deepen our partnerships and identify opportunities that might otherwise be missed. By connecting these local capabilities through Singapore, we believe we can build a stronger, more agile global entertainment business." 
 Creating Immersive Experiences through FriedRice Experience 
 An important pillar of FriedRice's next phase of growth is FriedRice Experience (FRX), its immersive and location-based entertainment business. FRX's Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Total Concentration Exhibition opened in Singapore in January 2026 and was extended to 12 April after strong demand. The overwhelming success of the event demonstrated the potential of internationally recognised intellectual property to create compelling physical entertainment experiences. 
 Building on this experience, FRX is developing a broader portfolio of immersive exhibitions and location-based entertainment projects for Singapore and selected Asia-Pacific markets in 2027. The business sees significant opportunities at the intersection of entertainment, technology, intellectual property and physical spaces. These include collaborations with international intellectual property owners, creative studios, cultural institutions, tourism destinations and property owners to develop exhibitions and entertainment experiences that attract audiences and enhance the appeal of physical destinations. 
 "Great spaces need great content. Physical infrastructure provides the canvas, but content creates the energy and gives people a reason to visit," said Mr Zou. 
 Connecting Eastern and Western Theatre Industries 
 FriedRice is also expanding into theatrical productions, international presentations and the development of original creative intellectual property. Building on its experience in live entertainment and international touring, the group is developing relationships with theatre producers and creative practitioners in Singapore, Shanghai, London and New York. 
 These engagements are focused on potential collaborations in theatrical programming, international co-productions, original content development and the presentation of theatrical works across different markets. For FriedRice, theatre represents an opportunity to extend its business beyond presenting established international entertainment and participate more actively in the creation, development and international distribution of creative works. 
 The group aims to bridge Eastern and Western theatre industries by connecting established international producers and creative expertise with talent and production opportunities in Singapore and Southeast Asia. Beyond bringing international theatrical productions to regional audiences, FriedRice also sees opportunities to support works originating in Singapore and Southeast Asia, helping them access wider audiences through international production and touring partnerships. 
 Through these efforts, FriedRice hopes to contribute to the development of a more connected entertainment ecosystem, in which creative ideas, production expertise and intellectual property can move more readily between markets. 
 Strengthening Singapore's Role in the Regional Creative Economy 
 While FriedRice's business ambitions are increasingly regional, the group sees Singapore as an important foundation for its long-term growth. Beyond its planned recruitment, FriedRice is engaging local arts organisations, creative studios, educational institutions, venue operators and other industry stakeholders to explore opportunities for collaboration, talent development and international market access. 
 The company believes that Singapore's creative ecosystem can benefit from stronger connections between the traditional arts sector and the commercial entertainment sector, particularly in the areas of audience development, professional production capabilities, creative entrepreneurship and access to international markets through international distribution. 
 Through its expanding regional network, FriedRice hopes to create new pathways for Singapore-based artistes, producers and creative professionals to collaborate with international counterparts and participate in projects beyond Singapore. This includes exploring opportunities to connect emerging creative talent with established industry practitioners and create practical exposure to the commercial and operational aspects of entertainment production. 
 "There is extraordinary creative talent in Singapore and across Southeast Asia, and every market brings its own culture, ideas and strengths. What is equally important is ensuring that talent has access to the right platforms, partners, production expertise and audiences to realise its potential," said Mr Zou. 
 "Our ambition is to build a commercially sustainable entertainment group that contributes to this ecosystem — one that creates jobs, develops capabilities, supports creative talent and builds intellectual property that can travel internationally. Ultimately, we want FriedRice to be recognised not simply as a company that brings international entertainment to Singapore, but as a Singapore-grown entertainment group that creates, develops and delivers exceptional entertainment experiences for audiences across Asia-Pacific and beyond." 
 Building the Next Chapter of Growth 
 With an expanding regional office network, a growing portfolio of live productions and new investments in immersive entertainment and theatre, FriedRice is entering a new chapter in its development. 
 Its immediate priorities will be to strengthen its Singapore operations, expand its regional teams and deepen partnerships with artistes, producers, intellectual property owners and creative organisations across Asia-Pacific. 
 Through these investments, FriedRice aims to establish a more integrated regional entertainment platform — one that combines international market reach with creative, production and operational capabilities anchored in Singapore. 
 As the group looks to the future, its ambition remains clear: to build a Singapore-grown entertainment business with the capabilities and international reach to bring creative ideas, talent and experiences to audiences across the world. 
 — END — 
 About FriedRice Entertainment 
 FriedRice Entertainment is a Singapore-headquartered live entertainment company operating across Asia-Pacific. Working with international artistes, management companies, producers and entertainment partners, the company develops and presents concerts, tours and live entertainment projects across multiple regional markets. 
 About FriedRice Experience 
 FriedRice Experience (FRX) is a Singapore-based immersive and location-based entertainment company focused on developing, producing and presenting exhibitions, experiential entertainment and intellectual property-driven attractions. The company works with international IP owners, creative studios and destination partners to develop physical experiences that connect content, audiences and places.
